origin: Self-trained in bashed-earth's own simulation (tools/neural/bashed_earth_lab.c linked against the game's objects). No third-party data or weights.
inputs: neural_features() in src/neural.c: 44 floats, shooter-centred and mirrored so the target is to the right, pixels / 1000
outputs: 14: 12 weapon scores (NEURAL_WEAPONS order, argmax over weapons in stock), then barrel angle 5 + 83*sigmoid degrees and power 10 + 90*sigmoid

training.method: supervised warm start (tools/neural/fit-demos.py, 60 epochs, minibatch Adam): angle and power from ballistic labels, weapon from the classic AIs' choices; evolution strategies continued from it lowered the selection reward and were stopped at generation 20
training.aim_labels: 100,000 variants of 4,000 training turns (bank seeds 1,000,000+) with the wind redrawn in [-20, 20] and the target moved; each labelled with the exact shot found by simulating the game's flight rule (50 deg barrel if it lands within 20 px, else the first of 60/70/80/40/30 that does; power in 0.25 steps)

target_rule: ai_pick_target(), shared with the classic AIs: weakest living opponent, lowest seat on ties
duel: duel k of seed S: match S+k vs personality k%5, gunner first when k/5 even; field 700-2000 px and settings drawn from the seed

selection.rule: top three by selection-bank reward, then most selection-duel wins

corrected_rule.bank: heldout2-1000 (seeds 9,600,000+), measured once after review K1

before_review.note: measured with Neural breaking health ties by distance (three- and four-tank turns only); corrected in review K1 to the classic seat rule its training labels used

held_out.ship_rule: pooled Wilson lower bound > 0.50 and >= 0.50 against each personality: passed
held_out.duels_note: one-on-one, unaffected by the tie rule; the first 200 replay identically after the fix
